ref.description: A record, by at-uri and the CID of the version meant.

projectView.description: An indexed plugin: its software.release.project with the registry's view of everything around it.

handle.description: The publisher's handle, when the registry can resolve one. Its absence says nothing about who owns the project.

name.description: The project's name, which is its record key.

channels.description: A map from channel name, such as `latest`, to the #channelRef it points at. Empty when no channel is indexed.

banner.description: The banner of the version the `latest` channel points at, when it has one.

lifecycle.description: The project's own lifecycle. Only `state` is set.

versionView.description: An indexed version of a plugin, with the artifact its manifest carries.

manifest.description: The software.release.manifest the version points at.

artifact.description: The plugin artifact from the manifest, as published.

availability.description: `available` means the registry holds the package and manifest bytes and serves them from getArtifact. `pending` means it has not copied them yet. `deletedAtSource` means the publisher deleted the version; the registry keeps serving what it already holds.

suspect.description: True when the publisher changed the version or its manifest after publishing it. Versions are immutable, so the registry keeps the first record it saw and flags this one.

lifecycle.description: The version's lifecycle, combined with the project's: the worse state of the two applies. `installable` and `events` are always set.

channelRef.description: The version a channel points at.

publicationView.description: The project's site.standard.publication, at the CID its at.happyproto.registry.project record pins.

icon.description: The CID of the icon, which getArtifact serves once the registry has copied it.

cid.description: The CID of the image, which getArtifact serves once the registry has copied it.

lifecycle.description: A lifecycle state derived from the publisher's software.release.status records. The last status that has not been withdrawn decides it: none means `active`; `endOfDevelopment`, `endOfSupport` or `supersededBy` mean `deprecated`; `endOfDistribution` means `unavailable`; `endOfLife` means `retired`.

installable.description: True when the state is `active` or `deprecated`.

supersededBy.description: The version to use instead, when the deciding status is `supersededBy`.

kind.description: The deciding status's kind, such as `security`.

events.description: Every status about the subject, oldest first, including withdrawn ones.

withdrawnBy.description: The status that withdrew this one. A withdrawn status no longer counts toward the state.

changelogView.description: The version's changelog, from the registry's copy of its site.standard.document.

markdown.description: CommonMark written by the publisher. Render it as untrusted input, with raw HTML stripped.
